plan.title: Aldosterone kidney DE, pathways and TF activity
plan.analytical_narrative: Human kidney bulk RNA-seq, 6 aldosterone-treated vs 6 vehicle control, unpaired, single batch, 12000 genes of raw Salmon gene-level counts with unknown length-correction state. The question asks which genes change and which transcription factors sit behind those changes, so the plan runs the Inflexa full_plan skeleton: sample-structure QC first (blind VST, PCA, sample distances, with the strandedness caveat recorded since the library strand is unknown), then a DESeq2 Wald two-group model with minimal pre-filtering, independent filtering at alpha 0.05, BH adjustment and apeglm shrinkage for reporting. The Wald statistic of every tested gene feeds two downstream reads of the same contrast: fgsea preranked GSEA against the human pathway collections staged in the reference store (MSigDB Hallmark plus WikiPathways human), and decoupleR ulm transcription-factor activity on CollecTRI signed regulons (DoRothEA A-C as the alternative), which answers the TF part of the question. A final report step assembles effect sizes, diagnostics, enrichment leading edges and a reproducibility record.

steps.name: Sample structure QC (blind VST, PCA, distances)
data: inputs/counts/counts.csv (12000 x 13 raw Salmon gene counts)
steps.do: Run sample structure QC before the model, per tpl-qc-eda@1.0.0: blind variance-stabilising transform (DESeq2::vst with blind=TRUE), PCA on the n_top_genes = 500 most variable genes, Euclidean sample-distance heatmap, per-sample library sizes (size factors). Colour by condition and by batch (single batch declared, verify). If aligned BAMs are staged, run RSeQC infer_experiment.py and record the strandedness result for every sample; if absent, state that strandedness cannot be verified from this import and that any count table built with a strand setting must be treated as unverified. Fail the step if PC1/PC2 is driven by a stray factor rather than the condition or batch.
steps.report: PCA scores and loadings, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes, strandedness inference table (or BAM-absent caveat)
steps.fails_if: PC1 explained by a factor other than condition/batch, or a sample isolated from its group

steps.name: DESeq2 Wald test, condition treated vs control, apeglm LFC shrinkage
steps.do: Differential expression on raw counts with DESeq2, per tpl-deseq2-two-group@1.1.0 and R-0001@9a17: keep raw counts (no pre-scaling/normalisation outside the model; median-of-ratios size factors named in the plan), design ~ condition, set factor levels with control as reference explicitly (relevel), factor levels control = reference. Contrast condition numerator treated denominator control so positive log2FC = higher in treated. Pre-filter minimally, per R-0029@22ca: retain genes with rowSums(counts >= 10) >= n_per_group_smallest (6 here) — do not over-filter, independent filtering in results() does the rest. Run DESeq() (Wald test, parametric fit), results(contrast=c(condition,treated,control), alpha=0.05), keep independent filtering ON with alpha=0.05. Report the p-value histogram before trusting adjusted p-values. Flag count outliers: DESeq2 Cook's distance behaviour on (N-1 < 7) sets padj/p to NA — report the number of genes NA from outlier flagging apart from the independent filter NAs, and inspect the raw counts of any flagged gene that matters to the question. Report LFC as apeglm-shrunken estimates via lfcShrink(type=apeglm, coef=condition_treated_vs_control) per R-0009@310d; keep unshrunken log2FoldChange and lfcSE in the table alongside. Summarise n_tested and n_de per contrast in the report per R-0041@978d.
steps.report: per-gene table: baseMean, log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue, padj, plus apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange; p-value histogram figure; MA plot; report header naming DESeq2 version, design, size-factor method, thresholds, n_tested, n_de

steps.fails_if: p-value histogram shows a mid-range hill or a rise toward 1 (report as fit caveat, do not present padj as reliable), or Cook's-distance NAs not reported per R-0039@968d

steps.name: fgsea preranked GSEA on the DE contrast statistic
steps.do: fgsea preranked GSEA per tpl-fgsea-preranked@1.0.0 and R-0098@d01b: rank ALL tested genes by the DE contrast statistic (stat), pass the FULL ranked list (no pre-thresholding on padj or log2FC), test the MSigDB Hallmark collection, state the rank metric in the report header. minSize=15, maxSize=500. Adjust within fgsea on the set p-values (BH). Universe = the tested genes mapped to Entrez per R-0101@976c; report the mapped share and the share of genes that failed the ID mapping.
steps.report: fgsea Hallmark results: pathway, ES, NES, pval, pval(BH), leadingEdge gene list; collection and release version; rank metric named in the header
steps.fails_if: fewer than 50 of the 50 Hallmark sets intersect the tested genes (report the size distribution and return), or fgsea unavailable

steps.name: decoupleR ulm TF activity from the contrast statistic
steps.do: TF activity per R-0121@7639: decoupleR ulm on the DE contrast statistic (stat) for all tested genes, using the CollecTRI human regulons (signed edges, mode of regulation kept). min regulon size 5. Universe = tested genes. Report the regulon collection version beside the result per R-0111@b668. Caveat: a prior-knowledge network is the same in every tissue, so a regulator inferred here can miss a tissue-specific regulator and a target that is silent here adds noise — state this in the report. If no regulon collection is resolvable in the environment, return TF inference absent and mark the step caveat instead of failing.
steps.report: TF activity table: source (collectri), statistic (ulm on stat), estimate, p-value, p-adjust(BH), targets per regulon; regulon collection version

steps.name: Report
steps.do: Assemble the report per tpl-report-bulk-de@1.0.0: design, package versions, size factors, thresholds, n_tested and n_de per contrast, MA plot, PCA, p-value histogram, gene tables (log2FC, lfcSE, stat, p, padj), and leading-edge gene lists per significant set with the gene-level statistic per member per R-0105@c4a8. State the shrinkage estimator in the table header, name the rank metric and the collection release beside the enrichment result, and state the method-dependence caveat for the enrichment result.
steps.fails_if: report missing design, thresholds, n_tested, n_significant, sessionInfo, or collection version

steps.name: Session record
steps.do: Write sessionInfo output with the results: DESeq2 version, DESeq2 version, design, size-factor method, thresholds, n_tested, n_significant, collection version, annotation release, R version. Per R-0086@becf the record includes sessionInfo, the seed, package versions, collection version, annotation release.

flags.message: If the strandedness of the library is unknown, infer it before the counting step, and before you trust a count table that a counter made with a strand setting. Run an inference on a sample of aligned reads against the annotation, for example the infer_experiment module of RSeQC, and record the result for every sample. A wrong strand setting counts the antisense reads of an overlapping gene, or it drops half of the reads, and the sample structure QC does not show the error.

If fewer than about 50 genes pass the significance threshold, do not run an over-representation test on that list. A hypergeometric test of a short list finds no category, and a change of the threshold changes the list and the result. Run the ranked method on the full list of tested genes instead, because it finds a set of genes with a small but coordinated change that no single gene shows. State the size of the significant list in the report.
